observations.content: User provided context-only reference packets for a later implementation task: per-session memory requires observers and consolidators to run with the owning session's `.memory/<sessionId>/` root as cwd, using the runtime-resolved root (not display name or project cwd), ensuring it exists before spawn while preserving worker behavior and handoff.

The supplied observational-memory plan specifies a phased implementation: Phase A observer-to-ledger-to-compaction/TUI, then Phase B consolidator and durable topic memory; a default-OFF per-session `/om` gate, ordinary recorded headless Pi worker sessions via child_process spawn, orchestrator-assigned observation timestamp IDs, and vendored minimal ledger logic.

The supplied repository reference says Phase A and Phase B are implemented, with per-session durable memory under `.memory/<sessionId>/`, keyed by immutable session-header ID; forks seed parent memory once excluding `.runs/`, and `/tree` does not roll back files.

The supplied implementation uses observer subprocesses to serialize fixed token-bounded conversation chunks into recorded `-p` prompts, commit observations and coverage watermarks to the branch-local ledger, and consolidate oldest overflow into scoped memory files with tombstones; compaction deterministically renders journey, map, and observations.
The supplied implementation tracks worker costs from Pi usage through `.runs` IPC into `om.cost` ledger entries; session totals count all branches and are surfaced in `/om:status` and the footer.

The supplied excerpts include implementation details for configuration, worker prompts/tools, compaction fast-path and resume handling, session memory seeding, scoped consolidator file tools, UI status/timeline, and tests for ledger folding, timestamp IDs, compaction cutoff, consolidator sandboxing, and cost tracking; no test execution or results were reported.
